recommendation: Keep this fixed commit. Leave historical release snapshots under tools/history unchanged, and route any future PlanDefinitionType terminology changes through THO/UTG rather than core FHIR source.
issue_request: FHIR-23876 asked to change the PlanDefinition type code name from clinical-protocol to protocol so PlanDefinition can represent lab, technical, study, and other non-clinical protocols; later comments clarified that this should be done by adding protocol through UTG rather than changing/removing the existing code in place.
initial_application: The prior FHIR-23876 implementation commit ceedc43fb48fa41b06d58d9a70d58c3fb3454c87 updated the active PlanDefinition.type short description and binding and removed the duplicate local PlanDefinition type value set. UP-655 implemented the protocol code in UTG/THO. The active PlanDefinition/protocol-example instance still used clinical-protocol, so application was incomplete in current source.
additional_context: FHIR-15163 is the earlier Published issue that introduced clinical-protocol after removing generic protocol; FHIR-23876 and UP-655 are the later decisions broadening support by adding protocol back. PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, the protocol example is listed in source/plandefinition/list-PlanDefinition-examples.xml, and Confluence/Zulip searches found supporting context but no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/plandefinition/plandefinition-protocol-example.xml so both the coded PlanDefinition.type and the generated narrative type line use protocol. No core terminology source was changed because the authoritative code system/value set content is now maintained in THO and UP-655 already implemented the code addition there.
source_changes: source/plandefinition/plandefinition-protocol-example.xml: changed the generated narrative type line from condition to protocol and the coded PlanDefinition.type from clinical-protocol to protocol.

related_jiras.note: Implemented the UTG/THO addition of protocol to PlanDefinitionType that FHIR-23876 comments identified as required.
Earlier Published CDS issue removed generic protocol and introduced clinical-protocol; FHIR-23876 later broadened the terminology by adding protocol back.
